title: Chemistry and Physics of a Low-metallicity Hot Core in the Large Magellanic Cloud
question: What are the chemical composition, physical structure and sulfur isotope ratios of a newly discovered hot molecular core around the high-mass YSO ST16 in the LMC, and how do its abundances compare with other LMC and Galactic hot cores?

what.value: Dust mass absorption coefficients 1.06 (1200 um) and 1.89 cm2/g (870 um) for ice-coated grains

evidence.quote: we here use 1.06 cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ for 1200 $\mu$m and 1.89 cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ for 870 $\mu$m
Tabulated ice abundances are adapted from (cite: ST16).

what.value: Galactic hot core abundances for comparison

evidence.quote: Abundances for Galactic hot cores are collected from (cite: Bla87; Tur91; Ziu91; Sut95; Schi97; Hel97).

external_data.citation: (cite: Bla87; Tur91; Ziu91; Sut95; Schi97; Hel97)

what.value: ST11 hot core abundances and sulfur isotope ratios

evidence.quote: The data for ST11 are adapted from (cite: ST16b) and those for N113 A1 are from (cite: Sew18).

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and fit line parameters
recipe.method: Spectra extracted from 0.42" circular region at continuum center; Gaussian fits to lines for Tb, FWHM, VLSR, integrated intensity
key_parameters: Detection criterion 2.5 sigma and velocity coincidence with CO clouds

recipe.method: LTE optically thin rotation diagrams; two-temperature fits split at Eu=100 K for CH3OH and SO2
assumptions: Optically thin, LTE; SO from SO(3_3-2_3) with Trot=50 K

recipe.method: Solve rotation diagram equation for N with assumed Trot (50 K for extended/SO/CS/CCH/CN, 100 K for compact)
Optically thin dust continuum at 870 and 1200 um; SED fits (Robitaille, Zhang & Tan); 9.7 um silicate depth; average adopted
assumptions: Dust-to-gas mass ratio 0.0027 (0.008 scaled by LMC Z~1/3); NH2/AV = 2.8e21; distance = LMC

recipe.goal: Fractional abundances and comparison with Galactic/LMC hot cores
recipe.method: N(X)/NH2; metallicity-scaled by factor 3 for LMC; compare with literature
Ratios of column densities of SO, SO2, CS isotopologues; weighted mean
Gas-grain model with cold (1e5 yr, AV 1-5 mag), warm-up (5e4 yr, to 150 K, 6e6 cm-3, AV 100) and post-warm-up (1e5 yr) stages; LMC vs Galactic

evidence.quote: The bolometric luminosity of the source is estimated to be 3.1 $\times$ 10$^5$ L$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$
we use $N_{\mathrm{H_2}}$ = (5.6 $\pm$ 0.6) $\times$ 10$^{23}$ cm$^{-2}$ as a representative value
we estimate the average gas number density to be $n_{\mathrm{H_2}}$ = 3 $\times$ 10$^6$ cm$^{-3}$ and the total gas mass to be 100 M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$
